Help & support

Trip estimates, expenses and rate confirmations in one place.

Get started

  1. Save your fuel economy and pay percentages in Truck settings.
  2. Enter your load payment, miles and expected costs under Check numbers first.
  3. Save the estimate. After delivery, enter final costs and the completion date in Saved trips.
  4. Use Weekly dashboard to review earnings for your selected dates.

Keep your records

Data is saved only on this device. Export trips, fuel purchases and earnings regularly; save original documents separately. Spreadsheet exports are not a complete restorable backup of all settings and documents.

Document scanning

Use PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each and 50 MB total. Convert HEIC photos to JPG first. First-use photo/scanned-PDF reading needs an internet connection. Review all suggested amounts and addresses before relying on them. Use Rescan, a clearer file or manual entry if reading fails.

Missing earnings?

Only finalized trips with completion dates inside your selected date range count. Saved estimates do not count. Business budgets and one-time business expenses also affect the total.

Report a problem

Open the Truckload issue tracker (GitHub sign-in required to report). Include the app/browser version, device and steps to reproduce. This channel is public: do not attach rate confirmations, customer addresses, financial records or passwords.

Use safely

Enter information while parked. Truckload is an estimate and recordkeeping tool; it does not provide truck-safe navigation, live fuel quotes, tax filing or guaranteed profit.
